thread:
incident-bot: [PAGER] SEV2 - ACME-CORP VPC gateway: websocket streams failing / timeouts. Triggered by 10% error rate on acme-vpc-gw pool (streaming). Paging @maria (oncall) and @sana (eng-sre). https://redwood.in/inc/1971000000 :fire_engine:

maria (oncall): acked. looking now - switching to incident channel. any indicators from infra?

david (infra): quick snapshot: errors are concentrated on dedicated pool `acme-dedicated-1` (tenant_id=acme-corp). Observed increased 504s and ws disconnects starting 10:11Z. CPU spiky on gateway pods + many `upstream reset` logs.

david (infra): paste logs:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:45Z [acme-vpc-gw-1] conn=0x7f12 ERR: ws read failed: ECONNRESET
2026-03-15T10:12:46Z [acme-vpc-gw-1] 504 GET /v1/realtime/stream tenant=acme-corp req_id=abc123
2026-03-15T10:12:47Z [acme-vpc-gw-2] conn timeout: idle 35s, keepalive missed
```

sana (eng-sre): is this isolated to ACME or broader? metrics for other tenants?

david (infra): 98% of failures have header `x-tenant: acme-corp`. other tenants look fine. looks like dedicated pool resource exhaustion + some TCP resets between gw and backend.

maria (oncall): ok. initial triage: customer-impacting for ACME realtime streaming only. Severity SEV2. Escalating to infra + platform. Jordan (acct-eng) please loop in ACME SRE/account contacts.

jordan (acct-eng): pinged ACME SRE (via email + slack DMs). they confirm client saw stream disconnects and increased retry attempts. they're standing by for mitigation steps.

sana (eng-sre): proposed mitigations (short-lived):
- move ACME traffic off `acme-dedicated-1` to fallback `dedicated-fallback-3` (same region)
- increase websocket keepalive/timeout on gateway to avoid aggressive kill on transient spikes
- restart gateway pods on acme-dedicated-1 with graceful drain to clear stuck connections

sana (eng-sre): routing command (run from infra runbook):
```
# switch routing weight 100% -> fallback pool
rctl route update --tenant acme-corp --target pool:dedicated-fallback-3 --weight 100 --sticky true --reason "emergency streaming mitigation"
```

maria (oncall): I'm rolling route change now. Posting command output once done. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-bot: Executing: `rctl route update --tenant acme-corp --target pool:dedicated-fallback-3 --weight 100 --sticky true`
ops-bot: Route update accepted. New routing propogation id=route-prop-9921.

maria (oncall): applied routing change at 10:21Z. watch windows enabled.

maria (oncall): restarting 2 gateway pods on original pool with drain flag to avoid dropping active requests:
```
kubectl -n vpc-gw rollout restart deploy/acme-vpc-gw --context=dedicated-acme-1
# wait for ready replicas
```

david (infra): observed errors drop to ~0.5% within 3 minutes after reroute. TCP resets decreased. Websocket connected count for ACME increased on fallback pool.

sana (eng-sre): good signal. next: we should harden keepalive and backoff so client retries don't hammer new pool. proposing gateway keepalive from 15s -> 30s and increase client idle tolerance to 60s. will prep config PR and runbook note.

jordan (acct-eng): emailed ACME: "We've applied a temporary routing mitigation and are monitoring. You may see reduced disconnects now; we'll follow up with permanent fix and timeline." (ACME responded: thanks, please keep updates) :white_check_mark:

maria (oncall): monitoring for 25m - error rate holding ~0.4%. marking incident as mitigated->monitoring. prepping handoff for evening oncall @lee.

maria (oncall): handoff notes:
- root cause: suspected gateway resource exhaustion + upstream TCP resets on `acme-dedicated-1` causing websocket timeouts for tenant acme-corp.
- mitigations applied: routing moved to `dedicated-fallback-3`, restarted gateway pods on affected pool, increased monitoring alerts for acme tenant streams.
- followups: infra to investigate kernel/TCP resets on `acme-dedicated-1` hosts; platform to apply keepalive/backoff config change; account to coordinate postmortem and customer comms.
- links: incident runbook https://redwood.in/r/runbooks/vpc-gw-streaming, route prop https://redwood.in/route/route-prop-9921, logs https://logs.redwood/corp/1971000000

lee (oncall-evening): ack handoff. I'll watch through the evening and will escalate if regressions. Can you add the followup tasks to the incident ticket?

maria (oncall): added followups to INC-1971000 and assigned to david/sana.

david (infra): initial postmortem tasks: collect tcpdump from 3 hosts in acme-dedicated-1, check for NIC flaps, kernel OOMs, and concurrency saturation. will prioritize.

jordan (acct-eng): draft customer message: "We're sorry for the disruption. We applied a temporary routing fix and will perform a root cause analysis. We'll share timeline for a permanent fix by EOD tomorrow." sending to ACME now.

incident-bot: Incident status changed: MITIGATED -> MONITORING by maria (oncall) at 1971002100.

maria (oncall): closing log: keep monitoring for 2h; if errors exceed 2% for ACME reopen and escalate to SEV1. thanks all :bow:
